purpose.question: is the remediated local target currently stable enough to justify pre-registering a complete fresh parameter-screening replicate
purpose.pass_consequence: permit result-free pre-registration of one complete fresh screening replicate with its own controls and unseen execution order
purpose.failure_consequence: stop local screening continuation and require an environment or protocol change before more tuning measurements

analysis_rules.precision: two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval around each arithmetic mean
analysis_rules.drift: absolute fitted first-to-last change from ordinary least-squares slope in chronological execution order
analysis_rules.operator_gap: block when any next-trial start occurs more than 15 minutes after the preceding trial completes
analysis_rules.decision: pass only when validity, TPS precision, p99 precision, TPS drift, p99 drift, and operator-gap gates all pass
analysis_rules.imprecision_without_drift: block without extension; the D025 contingency is not reused

retirement.reason: The operator accepted the completed D033 observations as final screening-phase evidence under an explicit post-result limitation and chose to continue to the primary-design milestone.

unresolved_decisions: Retired by D035 without execution; this historical design must not be launched.
